snippet.title: Dead Format | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Katanalevy and Oro Interactive are excited to announce the reveal of their game Dead Format, a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

Wishlist Dead Format on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399290/Dead_Format/
